subject: POC success metrics and evaluation plan — Medisolve trial follow-up
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@medisolve.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T16:10:00Z
Subject: POC success metrics and evaluation plan — Medisolve trial follow-up

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed minimal success definition we can agree to before we spin up the trial: this will help us scope infra, telemetries, and the measurement plan. I’ve attached a one-page workbook with the metrics and owners.

High-level ask: can you confirm these within 48 hours so we can book engineering time next week?

Proposed POC scope (30 days):
- Inference surface: document->structured summary + question-answering on clinical notes (batch + single-request flows)
- Traffic profile: sampling of 1k doc conversions then 100 live requests/day to start

Success criteria (candidate):
- Latency: median < 120ms, p95 < 400ms for single-request path (95th measured on warm servers)
- Throughput: sustained 40 requests/sec on peak step tests
- Cost: inference cost/token <= $0.0006 (target)
- Quality: extractive QA F1 >= 0.88 on agreed evaluation set; end-to-end QA top-1 accuracy >= 0.78
- Reliability: error rate < 0.5% over 24h smoke runs

Owners (proposed):
- Redwood: Ben (POC delivery), Rishi (SLA/cost), Hannah (commercial & escalation)
- MediSolve: Emma (project lead), ops@medisolve.com (integration)

Deliverables and measurement:
1) Kickoff + data ingestion checklist (day 0–3)
2) Smoke validation and baseline metrics (day 4–7)
3) Load/latency characterization and cost estimate (day 10–14)
4) Quality evaluation on 500 labeled examples and final readout (day 25–30)

Attachments: redwood_medipoc_success_criteria_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 54KB)

If this looks good, we’ll schedule the infra kickoff for next Tuesday (Nov 10) and Ben will own the integration checklist.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Trials & GTM Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@medisolve.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@medisolve.com
Date: 2026-11-06T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: POC success metrics and evaluation plan — Medisolve trial follow-up

Thanks Hannah —

Appreciate the clear plan. A few quick notes from our side: we’re comfortable with the overall 30-day cadence. We do have a slightly different tolerance for latency on the QA path — our clinical UI needs p95 < 300ms if the calls are blocking for the clinician. For batch document conversion the latency target is less strict.

On quality: we can commit to labeling 500 examples but need to split them across two reviewers; would you accept aggregated F1 on the merged set?

We’ll confirm owners internally by tomorrow. Ops has a short list of compliance checkpoints — I’ve copied ops@medisolve.com.

—Emma
Emma Jones
Director, Clinical Data Platform
MediSolve
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@medisolve.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-09T15:07:00Z
Subject: Re: POC success metrics and evaluation plan — Medisolve trial follow-up

Emma — thanks for the quick review and the latency callout — totally reasonable. Two operational clarifications from my side so we scope the test harness correctly:

1) p95 latency target: we’ll separate the measurement for
   - online (single-request, clinician-facing) path — target p95 < 300ms (as you requested)
   - async batch conversion path — target median < 1.2s

2) Data pipeline: we’ll need a stable sample of 500 labeled records and a separate 250 example hidden test set for final validation (to avoid tuning to the eval). Please confirm if your reviewers are comfortable with that split.

3) Telemetry and instrumentation: we will push a small agent that emits per-request latency, token counts, model variant, and error codes to a temporary project in your cloud account. We’ll provide a dashboard link and raw CSV daily.

Action items proposed:
- Emma: confirm reviewers + hidden test set access (due 2026-11-11)
- Ops: provide temporary service account with read-only access to ingestion bucket (due 2026-11-11)
- Redwood (Ben): stand up smoke infra and share dashboard (by 2026-11-14)

If these dates work I’ll block the engineering slots.

Best,
Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@medisolve.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-12T18:03:00Z
Subject: Re: POC success metrics and evaluation plan — Medisolve trial follow-up

Quick note on cost and SLA considerations so procurement has the right numbers for sign-off.

- Estimated inference unit cost (based on target model config + expected batching): $0.00052/token (projected median) — we’ll provide a day-14 tuned quote after the load characterization run.
- Burst capacity: we can provision a reserved pool for the duration at a small premium; if you expect spikes >100 req/s during testing we should lock that in now.
- SLA ask: for the trial we operate under best-effort, but we can offer 99.5% availability on the dedicated pool if you move to a reserved commit.

If you want me to prepare a one-page estimated cost sheet for procurement I can have it ready by Nov 15.

Rishi
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@medisolve.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, ops@medisolve.com
Date: 2026-11-18T09:37:00Z
Subject: Re: POC success metrics and evaluation plan — Medisolve trial follow-up

Emma / Ops —

Standing up next steps for clarity:
1) Owners confirmed: Emma (MediSolve lead), ops@medisolve.com (integration), Ben (integration lead), Rishi (cost & SLA), Hannah (commercial & readout)
2) Engineering kickoff: Nov 19 at 10:00 AM ET — Ben will share Zoom invite and initial checklist today
3) Deliverables timeline: Kickoff (day 0) → smoke baseline (day 4) → load tests & cost estimate (day 10–14) → quality eval & readout (day 25–30)
4) KPIs we will report on for the readout:
   - p50/p95 latency by path (online vs batch)
   - sustained throughput and peak capacity behavior
   - tokens-per-request and cost/token estimate
   - quality metrics: F1 and top-1 accuracy on the hidden test set
   - errors and reliability (5-minute buckets)

Please reply-all with confirmations on: reviewer split (500 labeled = 250/250 double-review, yes/no), bucket/service account access, and whether you expect any planned high-load spikes during testing.

If I don’t hear back by EOD Monday Nov 22 we’ll proceed with the nominal schedule and resource reservations; option to pause if you need procurement approvals.

Thanks and excited to get started —
Hannah
Head of Trials & GTM Programs
Redwood Inference
